jobs.title: Associate Manager, Business Operations
jobs.description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga, the global leader in mobile games, is currently seeking a full-time Associate Manager, Business Operations . We are looking for a highly organized, self-motivated operator who excels at cross-functional communication, process management, and relationship building.

In this role, you will act as a central pillar for Zynga’s Global Operations team. You will drive operational compliance, own end-to-end workflows for key cross functional projects, including our Global Fonts Program, and coordinate Player Data Compliance vendor proposals. This position bridges the gap between our global game studios and centralized corporate teams (Publishing, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering).

Our ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives on bringing people together, translating complex compliance requirements into actionable steps, and driving operational initiatives to the finish line.

What You'll Do

-
End-to-End Program Ownership: Lead the operational execution of key global workflows, initially anchoring the Global Fonts Program and the Player Data Compliance strategy across all Zynga games, acting as the primary central point of contact.

-
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central bridge between creative game studios and corporate teams (Publishing, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and Engineering) to review commercial terms, manage vendor proposal workflows, and ensure alignment on corporate standards.

-
Risk Mitigation & Data Integrity: Maintain critical tracking ecosystems (databases, software clearances, usage records, and active contracts) and drive proactive compliance initiatives, such as identifying and deprecating high-risk assets across the global portfolio.

-
Process Optimization & Innovation: Continuously evolve operational pipelines to drive efficiency; leverage modern tools (including generative AI like Gemini) to streamline workflows, and partner with technical teams to test and sign off on innovative creative pipelines.

-
Program/Project Management Support: Provide project management support for ad-hoc studio operations initiatives, including software migrations, tool rollouts, and M&A integration support.

What You Bring

-
Operational Experience: 2+ years of project management, program coordination, or business operations experience—preferably within software development, gaming, or compliance-heavy environments.

-
Relationship Builder: Demonstrated ability to earn trust, empower teams, and build strong, collaborative relationships across diverse cultures, disciplines, and work styles.

-
Exceptional Communicator: Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to synthesize complex legal or technical requirements into clear, data-driven updates.

-
Process-Oriented: Experience managing high-volume intake workflows, meticulously tracking approvals, and maintaining flawless documentation.

-
Autonomous Operator: Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive results with minimal supervision.

-
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), Airtable, and Atlassian tools (Jira/Confluence).

-
Bonus Points: Familiarity with generative AI tools (like Gemini) to optimize daily operations and workflows.

This is a perfect opportunity for an organized, self-motivated operator who wants to play a tangible, visible role in Zynga’s continued success. If you are ready to own critical processes and build the systems that help our global studios scale, we’d love to have you on the team.

What We Offer You

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $71,400 and $105,660 per Year.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such
as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. Ontario only: The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Zynga is looking for a highly organized and proactive Program & Business Operations Coordinator to join our CTO Strike Team - Contract & Vendor Management Team. This role sits at the intersection of contract management, business operations, and cross-functional coordination, making it a uniquely visible and impactful position within our global organization. You'll own critical operational workflows end-to-end, support contract administration and procurement processes, and serve as a trusted communication hub within the CTO Strike team.

What You'll Do:

- End-to-End Contract & Vendor Management Program Coordination Provide operational and administrative support to the program director of the Contract & Vendor Management team. This will include:

- Contract Administration & Procurement Support

- Serves as the internal business liaison for vendor contracts, including tracking and supporting Zynga-specific requirements.

- Coordinates renewal workflows for Zynga with the global procurement team, including data gathering, validation, and budget approvals..  This includes communication with the legal team and other internal stakeholders.

- Acts as the primary Zynga requestor, submitting contract requests, PO requests, and compliance due-diligence into centralized enterprise tools.

- Tracks and reports status updates for contract-related workflows.

- Ensures accuracy, timely approvals, and proper documentation.

- Creates renewal approval requests for pre-approvals and tracks approvals accordingly.

-

- Communication & Reporting

- Coordinates program updates via written summaries, status reports, and stakeholder communications.

- Prepares and maintains polished presentations for leadership reviews, team briefings, and cross-functional meetings, translating data and program progress into clear narratives as requested

- Risk Mitigation & Data Integrity

- Owns tracking software clearance, VSA, DPA, DPQ, and other forms to support compliance requirements.

- Flags and coordinates with the program director on any non-compliance issues for quick resolution.

- Assists with usage optimization to align on accurate data to ensure proper pricing and scale.

- Program/Project Management Support Provides project management support for ad-hoc operations initiatives.

- General Business Operations Coordination & Support

- Ad-hoc administrative and operational requests on special projects.

What You Bring:

- Operational & Business Experience

- 1-2+ years of experience in program coordination, business operations, or a similar role, preferably within software development, gaming, or compliance-heavy environments.

- Some experience with contract administration and/or PO creation is strongly preferred.

- Relationship Builder

- Demonstrated ability to earn trust, empower teams, and build strong, collaborative relationships across various disciplines, and work styles.

- Exceptional Communicator

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to write clear program summaries, updates, and business correspondence.

- Comfortable building and presenting polished slide decks to program leads and senior stakeholders.

- Process-Oriented

- Experience managing high-volume intake workflows, meticulously tracking approvals, and maintaining flawless documentation across contracts, POs, and program deliverables.

- Autonomous Operator

- Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive results with minimal supervision.

- Technical Proficiency

- Hands-on experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).

- Familiarity with ERP or procurement systems (e.g., JDE, Oracle, etc.) is a plus.

Bonus Points:

- Familiarity with generative AI tools (like Gemini, Claude, etc.) to optimize daily operations, accelerate reporting, and streamline workflows.

jobs.description:

As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

We are looking for an ASO & Partnerships leader to drive organic growth and deepen platform relationships for Merge Dragons, Monster Legends, Dragon City, FarmVille titles and many more. This role owns the studio's app store optimization strategy end-to-end and serves as our primary relationship holder with the major app store platforms — Google Play, the Apple App Store, Microsoft Store and Amazon Appstore.

You will lead a team responsible for improving organic visibility, store conversion, and featuring, while working closely with Product, Creative, UA, and Data teams to unlock sustainable organic growth and strengthen the top of the funnel. You will mentor and empower the ASO team to deliver best-in-class execution, and you'll be the studio's trusted voice in front of our platform partners.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

- Own the end-to-end ASO strategy for the portfolio, driving organic installs, store conversion, and keyword/category rankings across all markets.

- Define and manage the yearly organic growth roadmap, including localization, seasonal, and launch strategies.

- Set the studio's platform partnership strategy, aligning featuring and promotional opportunities with business priorities and release calendars.

Platform Partnerships

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with Google Play, Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, and Amazon Appstore partner teams.

- Secure featuring, editorial placements, and promotional opportunities across launches, updates, and key seasonal moments.

- Advocate for early access to platform betas, new store features, monetization tools, and APIs, and channel those opportunities back to Product and UA.

- Represent the studio in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry events, and negotiate co-marketing and joint business plans.

Performance Optimization

- Lead store listing experimentation (Custom Product Pages, Product Page Optimization, Google Play store listing experiments) to improve conversion rate.

- Own keyword and metadata optimization, and build rigorous test roadmaps across icons, screenshots, preview videos, and descriptions.

- Establish measurement frameworks to attribute organic uplift and quantify the impact of ASO and featuring initiatives.

Team & Collaboration

- Mentor ASO managers, specialists, and analysts; build structured career growth and execution excellence.

- Partner closely with Creative teams to fuel store asset testing velocity and creative breakthroughs.

- Collaborate with UA, Product, and Data teams to ensure cohesive full-funnel optimization and visibility improvements.

Operational Excellence

- Establish clear accountability for results with transparent reporting and actionable insights.

- Improve execution speed through better process, prioritization, and cross-team alignment.

Qualifications

- 6–10+ years of ASO or mobile organic growth experience in free-to-play, ideally in gaming.

- Proven track record of improving organic installs and store conversion at scale across multiple markets.

- Established working relationships with platform partner teams (Apple, Google, and ideally Microsoft and/or Amazon).

- Strong fluency in ASO tools (e.g. AppTweak, Sensor Tower, data.ai) and store listing A/B testing methodologies.

- Deep understanding of app store algorithms, ranking factors, and each platform's merchandising ecosystem.

- Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.

- Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple functions.

- Bonus: familiarity with Match-3/puzzle models and hybrid-casual or builder games.
